messages:
maria-ux: Quick accessibility review for Dashboard cards (Insights overview). Two issues: 1) focus order when tabbing across cards is non-linear — jumps from Card A header to Card C actions. 2) contrast on the card "kicker" label (small uppercase) is ~2.4:1 on light theme. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/dashboard-cards-contrast.png
devin-ui: I can repro the tab order. We render cards in a CSS grid and some cards are visually reflowed via order: using flex order for small screens. That can cause DOM vs visual mismatch.
rahul-qa: Repro steps: open Dashboard, press Tab repeatedly — on 1440 width, tab goes A header -> A settings -> C header. NVDA reads headings out of visual sequence.
kevin_m: Root cause likely DOM sequence doesn't match visual layout. Fix options: 1) keep DOM in logical reading order and use CSS grid placement to achieve layout; 2) keep current DOM but implement roving tabindex with aria-posinset/aria-setsize on card headers. Prefer #1 for simplicity.
maria-ux: Agree #1 is better for screen readers. Also for the kicker label contrast: it's small text (12px). We need at least 4.5:1 for small text? Actually WCAG small text requires 4.5:1. Current color #6b778c on white => ~2.4:1. Suggest #394b60 or use semibold.
devin-ui: I'll reorder DOM to match visual flow and remove use of order/flex for desktop. For responsive, we'll preserve logical order and use grid-template-areas. That should fix tab flow. Small change PR.
access-bot: a11y scan: MEDIUM: DOM order does not match visual order leading to confusing keyboard navigation; HIGH: kicker text contrast < 4.5:1 for small text; LOW: focus ring on card action buttons in high-contrast mode has 1px hairline which is not visible. Recommend 3px focus outline token on interactive card elements.
rahul-qa: QA note: add E2E test: assert DOM order equals visual order for the top-row cards at 1200px and 1440px. Also add keyboard nav test that tabs through headers left-to-right.
maria-ux: One more nit: sorting buttons in the table header have icons-only buttons with no aria-labels; SR reads "button" which is confusing. We need aria-labels like `aria-label=\"Sort by latency ascending\"` or use visually-hidden text.
devin-ui: Good catch. Those buttons are generated via an internal utils component that currently only renders <button class=\"icon-btn\" />. I'll update to accept `ariaLabel` and fallback to `title` attribute.
kevin_m: Also ensure when sort is active we set `aria-pressed=true` or `aria-sort` on the column header (e.g., `<th aria-sort=\"ascending\">Latency</th>`). Screen readers expect that.
access-bot: Additional suggestion: for sortable tables use `aria-sort` and expose a `role=\"button\"` on the interactive label. Provide live region update when sort changes like "Sorted by Latency, ascending" to surface changes for SR users.
rahul-qa: I'll add automated tests for aria-label presence on icon buttons and assert aria-sort toggles when clicking the column header. Also run axe on the modified page.
maria-ux: Thanks! Devin, can you include the contrast token change in the same patch? Propose new kicker token `--kicker-ink: #394b60`. Also update docs for when to use kicker vs caption.
devin-ui: Yep, I'll bundle DOM order + kicker color + aria-label changes. Small PR today. Will tag @kevin_m for review.
kevin_m: Quick non-blocking add: when adjusting focus rings, prefer tokens `--focus-thick: 3px solid #0ea5ff` for interactive items and `--focus-subtle: 2px dashed #ffd27a` for low-priority controls. Keep consistency across console.
maria-ux: Great. Let's track in the A11Y board and schedule a follow-up regression check after merge. Thanks team :thumbsup:
